prompt: 搜索关于 Gardner 方程 positon 解的相关论文，重点关注非线性动力学和孤立子理论方向

assertions.name: keyword_variants
assertions.description: Search keywords include Gardner equation, positon, breather and other variants

assertions.name: multi_round_search
assertions.description: Conducts at least 2 rounds of search

assertions.name: four_element_summary
assertions.description: Full-text papers show equation form, method, results, and innovation

assertions.name: core_paper_failure_notification
assertions.description: Notifies user immediately when core paper download fails

assertions.name: quality_journal_filter
assertions.description: Excludes MDPI and low-quality journals from the report
